attachments.displayName: Here's an updated lid for the Backwoods Logger case. I switched out the buttons for ones that were 10mm tall and they will probably work if I adjust the size of the button holes. They're a little too tight to push right now. I went to Home Depot to pick up M3 bolts but they only had one size and it was too short, so I ordered a bunch from Amazon prime which I should get in a couple days. I also added a vent so the internal pressure sensor would equalize with with atmospheric pressure. I noticed the layers shifted while printing and I checked out the X and Y belts. The Y belt was very loose but I tightened them both up and I printed a box and it turned out very nice. I should print another calibration cube to ensure my step values are alright because I printed a circular object a few days ago and it turned out lopsided. The work on a 3D printer is never done it seems.
